resources.string: ✅ Ready: on your iPhone hotspot at %1$s, port %2$d
⚠️ Connected to Wi-Fi (%1$s), but not to the iPhone hotspot. Join your iPhone\'s Personal Hotspot.
⚠️ Not on Wi-Fi. Join your iPhone\'s Personal Hotspot.
Enter this once in your iPhone Shortcuts. It makes sure only your iPhone can control this phone.
Lets Bike Link open Google Maps when a destination arrives from your iPhone.
Stops Android from closing Bike Link in the background during a ride.
Shows that Bike Link is running.
Lets commands from your iPhone reach this phone over the hotspot.
Taps \"Yes\" when you change destination mid-ride, and ends navigation when you send Stop Ride. In the list, open \"Bike Link – Maps helper\" and turn it on.

Taps \"Yes\" when you change destination mid-ride, and ends navigation when you send Stop Ride. In the list, open \"Bike Link – Maps helper\" and turn it on. If Android says it\'s a restricted setting: open App info for Bike Link, tap ⋮, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.

Taps Google Maps\' \"Yes\" button when you send a new destination mid-ride, and \"Close navigation\" when you send Stop Ride. It only acts for a few seconds after a command from your iPhone, only inside Google Maps, and reads nothing else.
Waiting for a destination from your iPhone.
